attempts.prompt: Create one static catalogue sprite of the fictional Greedy Worm from the 2007 Konami game Silent Hill: The Arcade, Toluca Prison stage, from the three supplied frames of this exact encounter. The first is context, the second sets the full near-frontal silhouette, the third shows its shallow side ridges. Match the appearance of the monster approaching down the passage in the original arcade footage, rendered in subdued, mottled brown, smoky grey and muted rose arcade-game materials. Camera almost straight down the animal’s long axis: its forward end conceals the receding extended trunk. Replicate only that fully bounded projected appearance. The silhouette is a thick rounded tapering oval, slightly higher than broad at this near-frontal angle, with two broad sloping dorsal folds, a dark shallow crease over the top, and a protruding circular mouth in its lower-front face. It has a thick, layered neutral-brown lip, a single irregular ring of modest short ivory teeth, and a muted dusky rose inner throat. Keep the ring and textures consistent with the source scale. The front hides the rest by perspective, with overlapping animal folds around and below the mouth. Do not give it a pinched spherical back, a visible tail tip, a separate head, a long neck, arms, legs, eyes or horns. In the reference the player's overlaid bright marks, dark vertical marks over the lower lip and labels are gameplay overlays and must be absent. One calm still of this creature, in original early-2000s real-time game rendering on genuine transparent alpha, 10 percent empty margin past every point; no text, room, bars, architecture, ground, cast shadow or effects. Use restrained arcade lighting from above on the folds so the full edge remains legible. No characters or other objects.
